name: Quorm
tagline: The operating system for community associations at portfolio scale.
positioning: Quorm gives enterprise property managers one system to run violations, assessments, board packets, and compliance across thousands of associations.

hero.h1: Run every association from one record of truth.
hero.sub: Quorm consolidates violation tracking, assessment collections, board packets, and reserve compliance across your entire portfolio — so managers stop stitching spreadsheets together at 11pm.

features.title: Violation lifecycle, closed by design
features.description: Log a fine, auto-generate the CC&R citation letter, escalate on schedule, and hand the ledger to counsel — every step time-stamped and audit-ready.

features.title: Assessments that actually collect
features.description: Batch dues, late fees, and special assessments across associations, then reconcile lockbox deposits to owner ledgers without manual matching.

features.title: Board packets in one click
features.description: Pull financials, delinquency reports, and ARC decisions into a formatted board packet minutes before the meeting instead of the night before.

features.title: Reserve & compliance tracking
features.description: Tie reserve study line items to funding status and surface every state disclosure deadline before it lapses into a fine.

features.title: Owner portal that deflects tickets
features.description: Homeowners pay dues, submit ARC requests, and view CC&R documents themselves — cutting the front-desk call volume your teams dread.

features.title: Vendor COI & W-9 vault
features.description: Track certificates of insurance and lien waivers per vendor, per association, with automatic expiration alerts before a landscaper lapses.

testimonials.quote: We onboarded 340 associations in a quarter. Violation letters that took a coordinator three days now go out the same afternoon, and our board packets are finally consistent across every community.
testimonials.name: Marisol Reyes

testimonials.quote: Delinquency reporting used to live in twelve different spreadsheets. Quorm gave our controllers one reconciled ledger, and our collection rate is up eleven points year over year.
testimonials.name: Derek Ansel

testimonials.quote: The COI vault alone paid for itself. We caught forty-two expired vendor certificates in the first week — exposure our old system never flagged.
testimonials.name: Priya Nadkarni
